confirmedEvidence.actualBefore: Root isolated full-app QA session605385... only watched YouTube; no download/record was clicked. Its media area contained a YouTube/.official/<receiver UUID>/chat-source/--Frag36 temporary chat response, and the normal exit dialog displayed 다운로드 1개.
confirmedEvidence.source: OfficialReceiver::is_active is leases>0 OR chat worker/assets not done. PlatformMediaService::active_ids appends live_active_ids, which emits platform-official:<receiver ID> and platform-live:<session ID> regardless of an archive. commands.rs active_work_snapshot_locked adds every such ID to downloads.active_count. ExitConfirmDialog renders that field literally as 다운로드. Therefore even an open live receiver without a chat response is incorrectly labelled as a download.
confirmedEvidence.notEvidenceOfDownload: The official chat binding starts only a receive-only chat worker, not a second video downloader or a user-requested recording. The temporary response does not establish a completed video file and is not used as one.
confirmedEvidence.actualClose: Root explicitly stopped the live view; the exit dialog then reported no active jobs and normal exit completed. This confirms the observed extra count was tied to viewing, not a hidden persistent media download.
confirmedEvidence.safeDrain: The existing normal exit closes admission, stops the native original host/continuations, finalizes an existing archive if present, closes receiver leases and stops chat, then waits for actual platform worker/lease ownership to drain. Its active IDs deliberately include watching receivers and must not be weakened.
